title: The 'Ask about your workout' journeys describe a Gym tab row the phone test says must be gone
what: The journeys start from an 'Ask about your workout' row on the Gym tab, a picker 'Who should answer?' with 'Any trainer or the owner', and a locked row with 'Renew my plan'. Since the change to one 'Message your gym' page, the phone test checks that this row is NOT on the Gym tab, and checks other words ('Who should read it?', 'Gym owner', 'Send message'). So these journey lines can never pass as written.
expected: The journeys say what the member really sees today on 'Message your gym', or the row comes back if the owner still wants it.
fix_line: Rewrite the ask-a-trainer journeys to the one Message your gym page

title: The 'how busy is the gym' card is never shown on a phone in any test
what: Only the words and the reading of the server's answer are tested. No phone test shows the busy card, checks 'Closed right now' on a holiday, checks the card does not flicker or stack two asks on a pull, or that it comes back after leaving and joining again.
expected: A phone test shows the busy card for a test gym with check-ins, closed hours and a holiday, and pulls to refresh.
fix_line: Add a phone test that shows the busy card open, closed and after a pull

title: The leaderboard card and the challenge goal line are never shown on a phone in any test
what: The leaderboard's words, the day totals and the server's ranks are tested as data. No phone test opens the leaderboard card: the top 10 with 'You', the challenge progress and end day, 'You hit the goal...', or the card being hidden when the gym has no leaderboard.
expected: A phone test opens the leaderboard for a test gym with a running challenge and one without the leaderboard.
fix_line: Add a phone test that opens the leaderboard card with and without a challenge

title: Pause my plan and Renew my plan are never used on a phone in any test
what: The day picking rules, the request lines and the server's rules are tested as data. No phone test opens the pause sheet, taps two days, sends, takes the request back, taps 'Got it', or checks that 'Request sent' does not show when the send fails or the phone is offline.
expected: A phone test sends a pause and a renew request on a test gym, takes one back, and tries one offline.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the pause and renew requests, including offline

title: The 'Send your report to the gym?' card is never shown on a phone, and a failed upload is never tried
what: Which workouts go into the report and the server's rules are tested. No test shows the card, 'Sending your report...', 'Report sent to the gym.', 'OK. Nothing was sent to the gym.', or the 'Try again' card after a yes whose file did not arrive. Nothing checks that 'sent' is not shown when the upload fails.
expected: A phone test answers yes and no to a report request from a test gym, and one with the upload failing.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the report card: yes, no and a failed upload

title: The workout offer card and its consent screen are never used on a phone, and the offer pop-up is never tapped
what: The card and consent words and what may leave the phone are tested as data. No phone test shows the offer card, opens the consent screen, taps 'Join the offer' or 'Not now', or taps the offer pop-up to check it lands on the card without skipping consent. 'Not now' writing nothing and the words for one extra day or one visit ('1 extra days', '1 times') are never tried.
expected: A phone test joins and declines an offer on a test gym, and opens it from the pop-up.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the offer card, consent, Not now and the pop-up tap

title: After leaving a gym, no test checks the kept gym hours are forgotten, or a new gym joined while an old leave still waits
what: Leaving is tested on screen and the offer and name switch are forgotten, but no test checks the phone forgets the gym's kept opening hours. No test opens a new invite link while an old leave is still waiting to be sent, to check the new link stays and the old leave still goes.
expected: Tests check the kept hours are gone after leaving, and that a fresh link and an old waiting leave both work.
fix_line: Add tests for the hours copy after leaving and a new link while a leave waits

title: The question box's 500-letter counter, the empty question line and a double tap are never tested
what: The refusal words are tested as data. No test types past 500 letters, sends an empty question to see 'Please type your question first.', or taps send twice to check only one question goes.
expected: A phone test types too much, sends nothing, and taps send twice on the question page.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the question box limits and a double tap

title: A member moved to a pass while an old paid plan still runs is never tried on the phone
what: The pass member phone test first cancels the member's paid plan, then gives a stand-in plan that the test build reads as the pass. So the case the journey names, a real old plan still running beside the pass, is never seen on screen, nor a waiting request kept after the move.
expected: A phone test moves a member with a running plan and a waiting request to a pass, and checks the pass words win and the request still shows.
fix_line: Add a phone test with a running plan kept beside the pass
